contract.themeContextWithToggle: ThemeProvider propagates theme through Context to direct and nested consumers
contract.nestedConsumer: Intermediate components do not prop-drill theme
contract.independentSubtree: Nested/independent ThemeProvider maintains isolated theme state

contributionFocus.description: Demonstrate the stated error or empty state, then a successful recovery on the next valid input without restarting the example.

steps.expected: main=light (direct & nested), independent=dark (direct & nested), orphan=fallback, errors=0
main consumers (direct & nested) become "dark"; independent subtree retains "dark"
independent subtree consumers become "light"; main consumers remain "dark"

steps.scenario: Main Provider Toggle Back to Light
steps.expected: main consumers become "light"; independent subtree remains "light"
error banner displayed with empty error text, empty state view active, consumers show "fallback-empty"
steps.actual: bannerText="Error: Theme name cannot be empty. Enter a valid theme (light, dark, solarized, ocean).", theme=fallback-empty

steps.expected: error banner displays unknown theme error message
steps.actual: bannerText="Error: Unknown theme 'cyberpunk-neon-invalid'. Supported themes: light, dark, solarized, ocean."

steps.scenario: Successful In-Place Recovery on Valid Input
steps.expected: error banner removed, empty state removed, consumers updated to "solarized", state=healthy
steps.actual: errorBannerCount=0, mainDirect=solarized, mainNested=solarized, status="Active theme: solarized (Solarized Sand) | State: healthy"

steps.action: Trigger invalid state -> Enter "ocean" -> Click Apply
